candidates.project: Concreting of Barangay Cabasaran to Barangay Dao FMR, Gamay, Northern Samar

budget.note: DBM FY2021 NEP and FY2021 direct-release material identify the same project and amount.

procurement.note: A 2021 report states the project was under contract with A-Cube Construction and Supply. This is useful corroboration but is not being treated as a recovered primary PhilGEPS record.

contract.note: The November 2021 report identifies the contractor and project engineer and says the project was already 43.60% accomplished as of 2021-10-31.

financial_execution.note: No project-specific ORS/DV/payment chain was recovered in the controlled search.

physical.note: DPWH/PIO-origin reporting later described the project as completed and published photos; this is evidence of an agency-reported completion, not an independent physical verification dataset.

oversight.note: No independent audit/acceptance record was recovered that could close the oversight relationship for the exact intervention.

implementation_evidence: Reported physical accomplishment was 43.60% as of 2021-10-31.
A later PIA report described the road as completed.
pip_ctrl_01g.expected_outcome: faster transport of farm/fish products, improved access to markets and services, local economic improvement
pip_ctrl_01g.result: Implementation evidence is stronger than for Candidate 1, but no quantified before/after travel-time, post-harvest-loss, farmgate-price, income, or comparable outcome measure was recovered.

adversarial_findings: G4 score is not recalculated; frozen result remains 3/8 for both candidates.
New evidence may strengthen individual relationship dossiers without retroactively altering the pre-registered gate score.
No missing record is treated as proof that an event did not occur.
No contractor/project relationship is treated as evidence of wrongdoing.
PIP-CTRL-01G is a cross-cutting research test, not a new G4 gate.
For Candidate 2, historical procurement/implementation evidence is materially stronger, but exact primary procurement and financial execution joins remain unresolved.
